exposure: mode of delivery (normal vaginal delivery vs. cesarean section)
cohort: The study included 32 females, with 16 delivered by normal vaginal delivery and 16 by cesarean section.
finding: Immune-related miRNAs (miR-181a, miR-146, and miR-150) are variably expressed in colostrum and mature milk, with miR-181a and miR-146 generally higher in colostrum, and their expression profiles are influenced by the mode of delivery.
mod_finding: The mode of delivery affects the expression profiles of immune-related miRNAs (miR-181a, miR-146, and miR-150) in colostrum and mature human milk.
cross-section timing: Colostrum and mature milk were obtained from each female postpartum.
